new_libraries.name: CampCooler
new_libraries.author: Camp Kitchen US
new_libraries.sentence: Food-safety alarm logic for a camping cooler thermometer (40 F / 4 C, 15 minute delay, hysteresis, min/max).
new_libraries.paragraph: Feed it temperature readings (for example from a DS18B20 probe) and it tells you whether the cooler is OK, warm, in alarm, or the probe is disconnected. Rollover-safe timing, silence and reset, no dynamic memory. Includes the Camp Cooler Watch example with LEDs, a buzzer and a CSV log.

new_libraries.name: Freenove_7_Inch_TouchScreen_Driver
new_libraries.author: Freenove
new_libraries.sentence: ESP32-P4 only. Driver for the Freenove 7-inch 1024x600 MIPI-DSI C-type panel (EK79007 + GT911 + I2C panel MCU).
new_libraries.paragraph: ESP32-P4 only (MIPI-DSI). Fully self-contained: panel power/reset and backlight via on-panel MCU I2C (0x45). Exposes an RGB565 framebuffer for LVGL or direct drawing, and reads GT911 touch over Wire. Other ESP32 chips will fail at compile time.

new_libraries.name: Freenove_Es8311_Audio_Driver
new_libraries.author: Freenove
new_libraries.sentence: Arduino driver for ES8311 codec + I2S audio on Freenove ESP32-P4 boards.
new_libraries.paragraph: Wraps ESP_I2S for PCM in/out and programs the ES8311 over Wire with the same open / set_fs / start sequence as Espressif esp_codec_dev. Includes PA enable and Freenove ESP32-P4 pin defaults.

library.name: BuzzerPIO_RP2040
library.author: Ângelo Moisés Alves
library.sentence: Ultrasonic PWM tone generation for passive buzzers using the RP2040 PIO coprocessor.
library.paragraph: Dual state-machine architecture: SM1 generates an ultrasonic PWM carrier (~95 kHz) for distortion-free volume control, SM2 gates it at the audible frequency. Uses only 4 PIO instructions, auto-probes both PIO blocks, zero DMA, zero IRQ handlers. Multi-core safe via hardware spinlock. Coexists with OneWirePIO, DHT22PIO, and CYW43 WiFi. Non-blocking melody sequencing via hardware alarm chain with completion callback. Pause/resume support. Perceptually linear volume curve. Drop-in replacement for v1.x/v2.x.
